design_view.traffic_definition: cumulative bytes per directed physical hop during one inference; not simultaneous bandwidth or point-to-point payload sum

report.area_definition: sum of compute die areas; excludes package and external DRAM
report.performance_definition: single-inference latency upper bound in seconds; lower is better
report.power_definition: total accounted energy / single-inference makespan; average power, not peak power

summary.limitations: finite count/output-partition candidates; short same-workload learning; no global-optimum or silicon PPA guarantee

reward_contract.global_reference: unmeasured archive sentinel J=1; measured J=M/(1+M); fixed vendor-limit scales or declared SI unit scales
